nodes.name: Prospective memory + value of asking + interruption modeling -> Intent Externalization Controller
nodes.description: Capture every candidate intention in an evidence-backed ledger, but choose a trigger, user question, or silence independently. Estimate the cost of forgetting and the potential value of clarifying what matters. Use an explicit non-LLM rule for critical deadlines even if the interruptibility model is uncertain. A reminder may be bound to a situation (before a meeting, when a document becomes ready, at a planned breakpoint), not just a clock.

nodes.name: Task interruption + ready-to-resume planning + robust schedule stability -> Work-Resumption Guardian
nodes.description: If an interruption is authorized and valuable enough, capture `current_objective, next_step, unfinished_decisions, relevant_artifact, safe_return_condition` as a resumption capsule. Predict earliest feasible return, optionally create a protected recovery block, and re-optimize around it with a penalty for schedule churn. Do not demand that the user write a resume note; infer only when there is adequate evidence, otherwise use an optional one-line confirmation.

nodes.name: Distributed cognition + secretarial work + implicit coordination -> Situational Coordination Graph
nodes.description: Model *who expects what from whom*, not just what the user intends to do. Store `actor, counterpart, requested_outcome, evidence, deadline, expected_reply, external_state, authority`. Monitor non-events only if a reply was expected **and** the source has sufficiently fresh coverage. Prepare appropriate handoffs or follow-ups rather than automatically sending them. Existence of a sent message is not evidence that someone agreed.

nodes.name: Goal systems + goal shielding + adaptive disengagement -> Personal Goal Portfolio Controller
nodes.description: Represent a user-chosen goal as `desired_outcome + alternative_ways + boundaries + indicators + revision_policy`. Distinguish *ends* from *means*: learning robotics could be advanced through study, projects, mentoring or reading. A single failed routine does not imply failure of the goal. Shield explicit protected goals from routine administrative encroachment, while permitting renegotiation on genuinely urgent occasions. Model `pause | revise_means | continue | retire_with_consent` instead of endless streaks.

nodes.name: Planning-fallacy research + stochastic scheduling + queueing -> Capacity and WIP Governor
nodes.description: Estimate conditional task-duration distributions from calibrated history (with shrinkage to population priors), not one fixed duration. Incorporate transition costs, hard constraints, protected time, source uncertainty and buffers. Limit simultaneous *active* work only where the measured process supports a WIP-based policy; never apply Little's Law mechanically to heterogeneous personal goals or assume reducing WIP always increases productivity. Use rolling-horizon feasible scheduling and penalize movement of previously accepted commitments.

nodes.name: Rational metareasoning + progressive escalation -> Computation and Question Budget
nodes.description: Route trivial tasks to deterministic rules, non-urgent ambiguous tasks to delayed deeper computation, and high-impact uncertain tasks to bounded deliberation plus explicit confirmation. Define `EV_computation` and `EV_question` separately. Do not use a powerful multi-agent pipeline for a low-risk calendar lookup. Require cost ceilings and deadlines for deliberation; stop when marginal expected benefit falls below marginal cost or a time constraint is reached.

nodes.name: Conservative online learning + selection-bias research -> Auditable Personalization Policy
nodes.description: For every suggested action record `context, candidates, filtering_reason, shown_actions, selection_probability, policy_version, stated_user_feedback, later_outcome`. Avoid treating clicks, silence, or dismissals as unambiguous preferences. Use staged rollout: static baseline -> shadow policy -> randomized low-risk comparisons where consented -> calibrated personalized policy. Never explore external side-effect permissions; those require explicit grants. Use propensity correction only where overlap and defensible exposure probabilities exist.

nodes.name: Evolving memory benchmarks + temporal representation -> Belief Maintenance, not 'Chat Memory'
nodes.description: Keep raw evidence, immutable-by-default event traces subject to deletion rules, current working state, episodic experience, semantic scoped beliefs, relational knowledge, procedural verified skills and uncertainty calibration. Each claim has valid time, observed time, source evidence, explicit/implicit origin, confidence and `supersedes` links. At retrieval, filter by context and valid time *before* semantic similarity. A memory write is a state transition with contradiction checks, not appending a sentence to a memory block. Never let an implicit habit silently override a current explicit constraint.

nodes.name: Autonomous convenience + skill preservation -> Competency-Preserving Delegation
nodes.description: Partition work into `administrative overhead`, `expert judgment`, `practice/learning`, `high-stakes human decision`. Default to automation of low-risk overhead. For user-declared growth/skill targets, let the user choose deliberate practice; provide feedback only after the user's attempt if they opt in. Do not impose mandatory educational friction on unrelated administrative work. Include `ability_preservation` as a long-term evaluation guardrail, not a secret reward.

nodes.name: Goal-lapse research + adaptive self-regulation -> Exception-Aware Routine Learning
nodes.description: Model routine as a conditional policy with `trigger, time_window, goal_relation, context, suspension_conditions, preferred_recovery_options`. Distinguish one-time exception, repeated schedule conflict, seasonal shift, and actual goal change using changepoint hypotheses. `Missed` must never automatically mean `disliked`; if effect on future decisions matters, ask a short contextual question. Track progress against meaningful evidence, not streaks.

nodes.name: Saga transactions + agent planning validation + official execution semantics -> Verified Responsibility Closure
nodes.description: Separate reasoning from execution. Every external effect has typed preconditions, authorization check, business idempotency key, expected postconditions, read-after-write verification, timeout and compensation or recovery procedure. `Provider accepted` is not `recipient agreed`; `calendar update requested` is not `verified on provider`. A reply expectation remains `waiting_external` until acknowledged, canceled or expired. On uncertain execution, reconcile before retrying. Compensation can be impossible for sent messages, so require an explicit pre-send gate.

nodes.name: Bounded attention + long-term goals + secretary practice -> Focus Allocation with Critical-Omission Constraints
nodes.description: Jointly choose `which responsibility`, `when to intervene`, `how much information`, and `who acts`. Never equate priority with interruptibility or user preference with authorization. Use a constrained decision objective, not a pure ranking. Preserve focus where possible, yet override it for high-consequence exceptions; use expected value of information for questions and a source-of-truth view for audit. Long-term goals can be protected via explicit reserved capacity rather than secretly weighting 'growth' as a universal value.
